name: Main Mission Gurgaon \ 5K \ Galleria Market \ NOV 1

location.name: Galleria Market, Gurgaon
location.address: Galleria Market, Gurgaon, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

description:
About This Event

Make this your day one of running. Main Mission is coming to Gurgaon for the first time, and we'd love for you to be part of our first community 5K here. If you've been waiting for a reason to start, this is it. Come for the run, meet your running people and stay for a post-run hang at FES Cafe.

What To Expect

Report at Galleria Market at 6:45 AM for check-in and a warm-up with the run leads. Then head out for a 5K together, with run leads at the front and back of the group. We'll finish with a post-run hang at FES Cafe.

Who Is This For

First-time runners, anyone who's been meaning to start, and regular runners looking for a community in Gurgaon. You don't have to be fast to join. All paces are welcome.

What's Included

• A warm-up led by the run leads

• A 5K community run

• A post-run community hang at FES Cafe

• Cookies and Coffee on us!

name: FormLabAI by MM Gurgaon (In-Person Session) | NOV 1

location.name: DRIVE FITT Gurgaon
location.address: DRIVE FITT Gurgaon, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

description:
About This Event

Make this your day one of understanding your running form. Main Mission is coming to Gurgaon for the first time, and we're bringing FormLabAI to help you get to know how you run. Whether you're just starting or have been running for years, come get curious about your form and find a starting point for what to work on.

What To Expect

Join us at DRIVE FITT for a 3-minute treadmill run. FormLabAI analyses video of your cadence, stride and knee angles, then gives you a form score and a starting point for what to work on first. The event runs from 1:00 PM to 3:00 PM, with only 15 slots available.

Who Is This For

First-time runners, anyone who's been meaning to start, and regular runners curious about their form. You don't have to be fast to join, just curious about how you run.

What's Included

• A 3-minute treadmill run for your assessment

• AI-powered video analysis of your cadence, stride and knee angles

• Your running-form score

• A starting point for what to work on first
